error_ledger.bias: Known impedance sensitivities include network absolute tolerance7.5%, separate from ratio precision. Unknown input-source/protection, REF output and return impedances remain additional.15nA PW evidence is conditioned, not a universal off-state/commonmode bound.
error_ledger.calibration: No knob fitting performed. Existing two user pots remain rank2; improved CV matching is passive ratio control, not a third adjustment actuator or permanent calibration.
error_ledger.load: Same setting open-to10k at-5/0/+5V; existing feedback controls998ohm feedforward drop while linear. Neither that drop nor zero from this load-free model is a residual-load result.
error_ledger.modeled: Nominal loaded wipers plus coherent shared summer/restore ratio witnesses and unchanged atten/negative-reference ratios.
error_ledger.offsets: Ten amplifier contributions with actual coherent gain coefficients.100uV table-conditioned sensitivity, not guaranteed installed +/-12V full-temperature error. No offset calibration subtraction.
error_ledger.reference: Common source initial-error sensitivity enters REF_positive once; inversion propagates it. REF_positive amplifier offset and REF_negative amplifier offset are distinct. Drift/noise/regulation/charge/stability remain open.
error_ledger.return: Actual source-to-receiver ground displacement times each signal gain plus shared return paths; no equal sharing, allocation-as-copper or blanket2mV assignment.
error_ledger.temperature: Full-temperature network ratio spec used once. No additional matchingTC or absoluteTC added. Remaining resistors/pots/amplifiers/reference/thermal gradients need separate operating evidence.

finite_recommendation: Stop after candidate source integration. Preserve precision intent. Next separately scoped work must define the A01 operating-temperature/calibration/error allocation and evaluate the retained reference-inverter ratio and control-loading contributions against a reserved remainder for amplifier/reference/load/return effects. Identify one justified necessary correction with a closed contribution budget before further implementation. These networks alone do not establish2mV complete static or1mV load-change accuracy. No automatic component search, knob fitting, product-role downgrade or hardware execution.

network_loading.buffer_scope: Sum actual signed branch currents at each output once; summer output supplies both feedback R7124 and restore input R7125. Other existing loads, feedback currents, rail IQ and transient parasitics remain additional. Not a total rail current guarantee.
network_loading.parasitic_scope: 5.5pF resistor-to-EP and1.4pF resistor-to-resistor are typical, not maximum lumped capacitor guarantees. No pole, settling/noise/stability or EMI acceptance inferred.
